title: Life-Domain Status Wall
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=lifeos:score OR sourcetype=streak:status)
| stats latest(score) as score by domain
| eval status=case(score>=80,"green",score>=60,"amber",1=1,"red")
| sort domain
description: Presents every area of your life as a status tile — green, amber, red — like an operations centre wall for yourself.
value: A single glance tells you which part of life needs attention today, the way a NOC wall does for systems.
implementation: Combine life-domain scores in `index=personal`; render red/amber/green status tiles.
visualization: Status-tile wall of life domains by health.
grandmaExplanation: It shows each part of your life as a green, amber, or red light, so one glance tells you what needs attention.
